question: List the full names of vampire superheroes who have more powers than the average number of powers per superhero and do not have blonde hair.

prediction.sql:
WITH all_power_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    s.XCL_018 AS hero_id,
    COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS power_count
  FROM superhero s
  INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
  GROUP BY s.XCL_018
),
avg_powers AS (
  SELECT AVG(power_count) AS avg_count
  FROM all_power_counts
),
vampire_heroes AS (
  SELECT 
    s.XCL_018 AS hero_id,
    s.XCL_020 AS full_name
  FROM superhero s
  INNER JOIN race r ON s.XCL_025 = r.XCL_016
  WHERE r.XCL_017 = 'Vampire'
)
SELECT vh.full_name
FROM vampire_heroes vh
INNER JOIN all_power_counts apc ON vh.hero_id = apc.hero_id
CROSS JOIN avg_powers ap
WHERE apc.power_count > ap.avg_count
  AND vh.hero_id NOT IN (
    SELECT s.XCL_018 
    FROM superhero s 
    INNER JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_023 = c.XCL_005 
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blond'
  )

WITH all_power_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    s.XCL_018 AS hero_id,
    COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS power_count
  FROM superhero s
  INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
  GROUP BY s.XCL_018
),
avg_powers AS (
  SELECT AVG(power_count) AS avg_count
  FROM all_power_counts
),
vampire_heroes AS (
  SELECT 
    s.XCL_018 AS hero_id,
    s.XCL_020 AS full_name
  FROM superhero s
  INNER JOIN race r ON s.XCL_025 = r.XCL_016
  WHERE r.XCL_017 = 'Vampire'
)
SELECT vh.full_name
FROM vampire_heroes vh
INNER JOIN all_power_counts apc ON vh.hero_id = apc.hero_id
CROSS JOIN avg_powers ap
WHERE apc.power_count > ap.avg_count
  AND vh.hero_id NOT IN (
    SELECT s.XCL_018 
    FROM superhero s 
    INNER JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_023 = c.XCL_005 
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blond'
  )

WITH power_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    s.XCL_018 AS hero_id,
    s.XCL_020 AS full_name,
    COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS power_count
  FROM superhero s
  INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
  INNER JOIN race r ON s.XCL_025 = r.XCL_016
  WHERE r.XCL_017 = 'Vampire'
  GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020
),
avg_powers AS (
  SELECT AVG(power_count) AS avg_count
  FROM power_counts
)
SELECT pc.full_name
FROM power_counts pc
CROSS JOIN avg_powers ap
WHERE pc.power_count > ap.avg_count
  AND pc.hero_id NOT IN (
    SELECT s.XCL_018 
    FROM superhero s 
    INNER JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_023 = c.XCL_005 
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blond'
  )

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    s.XCL_019 || ' ' || s.XCL_020 AS full_name
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    race r ON s.XCL_025 = r.XCL_016
JOIN 
    colour c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
JOIN 
    hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
WHERE 
    r.XCL_017 = 'Vampire'
    AND c.XCL_006 != 'Blond'
GROUP BY 
    s.XCL_018
HAVING 
    COUNT(hp.XCL_013) > (
        SELECT 
            AVG(power_count)
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                COUNT(hp2.XCL_013) AS power_count
            FROM 
                hero_power hp2
            GROUP BY 
                hp2.XCL_012
        )
    )
